fields.subject: Mapper
fields.trigger: a caller materializes one model from a data-reader result set
fields.response: map exactly one row into the supplied model or a newly created model using the supplied Shard identifier; return the default model value when the reader has no rows; and reject a result set containing more than one row with UnexpectedMultiRowResultException
